title: Maggi Noodle Soup with Frozen Momos

items: 1 cup extra water for the soupy texture

method: Add water to a pot this would include the normal amount you put to make a packet along with 1 cup extra to get that soupy texture add in the maggi and tastemaker along with extra masala packet and boil
Add the momos to a plate and micro for around 30-40 seconds till slightly thawed
Add this to the maggi in the pot and allow it to get nice soft and absorb some flavoyr as well
Once ready, add to your serving bowl, top with momo packet sauce and coriander and enjoy :)
tips: -add in some chicken / paneer to increase protein of the meal
I used 4 chicken meatballs which gave me an additional 25 grams protein to this meal
-you can replace the maggi noodles with whole wheat hakka and use just the tastemaker

Serves 1

pro tip:
-add in some chicken / paneer to increase protein of the meal 
i used 4 chicken meatballs which gave me an additional 25 grams protein to this meal
-you can replace the maggi noodles with whole wheat hakka and use just the tastemaker

Ingredients
1 packet of maggi noodles @maggiindia 
1 cup extra water for the soupy texture
extra half packet, maggi masala 
4 - 5 frozen momos 

Method: 
add water to a pot this would include the normal amount you put to make a packet along with 1 cup extra to  get that soupy texture  add in the maggi and tastemaker along with extra masala packet and boil 
add the momos to a plate and micro for around 30-40 seconds till slightly thawed
add this to the maggi in the pot and allow it to get nice soft and absorb some flavoyr as well
once ready, add to your serving bowl, top with momo packet sauce and coriander and enjoy :)
